stories.title: Présidentielle 2027 : le PS cherche à éviter que l’affaire Philippe Brun entache sa primaire

en.title: 2027 Presidential Election: PS seeks to prevent Philippe Brun affair from tarnishing its primary
en.summary: A French Socialist Party deputy suspended and excluded from the party's primary following accusations from a former colleague denied wrongdoing at a press conference, claiming he was being targeted for political destruction.

stories.title: Ursula von der Leyen propose de faire du Canada le «premier membre associé» de l’UE

en.title: Ursula von der Leyen proposes making Canada the EU's "first associated member"
en.summary: The European Commission president proposed strengthening ties between the European Union and Canada by granting it an unprecedented new status during her address to the European Parliament.

stories.title: Carburants : Lecornu a demandé à ses ministres de «prolonger» jusqu’au 31 décembre les aides ciblées

en.title: Fuel: Lecornu asked his ministers to 'extend' targeted aid until 31 December
en.summary: France's government is extending targeted fuel subsidies through the end of the year following a presidential directive for mobilized action on fuel supply and price control.

stories.title: Prix des carburants : Sébastien Lecornu prolonge les aides ciblées jusqu’au 31 décembre

en.title: Fuel prices: Sébastien Lecornu extends targeted aid until 31 December
en.summary: The French government is extending targeted fuel support measures through December 31st in response to presidential demands for coordinated government action on fuel supplies and pricing.

stories.title: Hausse des prix du carburant : le gouvernement va prolonger jusqu'au 31 décembre ses aides à certaines catégories professionnelles

en.title: Rising fuel prices: government to extend aid to certain professional sectors until December 31
en.summary: The French government will continue financial assistance through year-end for fishing, agriculture, and eligible construction sector businesses facing elevated fuel costs.

stories.title: Ursula Von der Leyen suggère que le Canada devienne "membre associé" de l'UE

en.title: Ursula von der Leyen suggests Canada become EU "associated member"
en.summary: The European Commission president proposed Canada becoming the EU's first associated member amid deteriorating Canada-US relations, prompting Donald Trump to threaten trade restrictions against Europe.

en.title: Trial opening for Rachida Dati, ban on social networks for under-13s in the EU, 21 dead in Gaza… Wednesday September 16 news
en.summary: Libération reports on major news events of the day, including the opening of Rachida Dati's trial, EU social media restrictions for minors, and casualties in Gaza.

stories.title: France : retour sur les raisons du procès de Rachida Dati et Renault-Nissan

en.title: France: Background on Rachida Dati's trial and Renault-Nissan
en.summary: Rachida Dati faces trial starting Wednesday for corruption and influence trafficking, accused of receiving 900,000 euros from former Renault-Nissan CEO Carlos Ghosn while serving as MEP; Ghosn is also being prosecuted.

stories.title: Ursula von der Leyen propose au Canada de devenir «membre associé» de l’UE, l’Allemagne s’oppose au terme

en.title: Ursula von der Leyen proposes Canada become EU 'associate member', Germany opposes the term
en.summary: European Commission President von der Leyen proposed a new associate member status for Canada during her State of the Union address to the European Parliament, with Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney receiving a standing ovation. Germany expressed opposition to the proposed terminology.

stories.title: «Porter notre relation au plus haut niveau possible» : l’Union européenne propose au Canada un statut de «membre associé»

en.title: "Raise our relationship to the highest possible level": European Union proposes Canada an "associate member" status
en.summary: The European Union proposed elevating its relationship with Canada through a new associate member status. Canada could also join a future European security council alongside the United Kingdom, Norway, and Ukraine.

stories.title: Le Canada, futur premier "membre associé de l'UE" ? Ce que l'on sait du statut inédit proposé par Ursula von der Leyen

en.title: Canada, future first EU "associate member"? What we know about the unprecedented status proposed by Ursula von der Leyen
en.summary: European Commission President von der Leyen proposed an unprecedented associate member status for Canada during her State of the Union address delivered before European lawmakers in Strasbourg to Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney.

stories.title: Interdiction des réseaux sociaux aux moins de 13 ans, Conseil de sécurité de l’UE, Canada… Ce qu’il faut retenir du discours d’Ursula von der Leyen

en.title: Ban on social media for under-13s, EU security council, Canada… Key takeaways from Ursula von der Leyen's speech
en.summary: European Commission President von der Leyen outlined major policy initiatives during her State of the Union address to the European Parliament in Strasbourg, covering social media restrictions for minors, EU security matters, and international relations.

stories.title: Primaire PS : premier coup de tonnerre. La chronique de Pierre Lepelletier

en.title: Socialist Primary: first bombshell. Pierre Lepelletier's column
en.summary: The Socialist Party primary campaign has been marred early by the exclusion of Philippe Brun, who faces allegations of violence from a former colleague.

stories.title: 394 milliards d’euros : ce que la prudence des épargnants français leur a coûté (en théorie)

en.title: 394 billion euros: what French savers' caution has cost them (in theory)
en.summary: J.P. Morgan AM estimates that 475 billion euros placed by French households in liquid assets since 2020 would have generated 394 billion euros more in global equities, though the calculation relies on retrospective simulation rather than actual losses.

stories.title: La Fed relève ses taux et ouvre une nouvelle séquence monétaire

en.title: The Fed raises rates and opens a new monetary sequence
en.summary: The Federal Reserve increased rates by 25 basis points, marking a return to monetary tightening as inflation and oil prices complicate conditions under new leadership.

stories.title: Avec son algorithme, OùSoigner veut accélérer l’installation des médecins dans les déserts médicaux

en.title: With its algorithm, OùSoigner wants to accelerate doctor placements in medical deserts
en.summary: OùSoigner is a collaborative platform using an algorithm to match physicians seeking to establish practices with underserved communities lacking medical professionals.

stories.title: Avec 61 milliards d’euros de dividendes, la France prend la tête en Europe

en.title: With 61 billion euros in dividends, France takes the lead in Europe
en.summary: Major French listed companies distributed 61 billion euros in dividends to shareholders, placing France first in Europe and second globally after the United States.
